what_this_is: The Workshop row for the better-auth folder: the documented Better Auth server (better-auth-rs on axum) that signs people in with email and password or a passkey and issues JWTs verified against its JWKS.

payload.label: Run the Better Auth sign-in server (runs on your computer)
payload.job: Start the sign-in server: email and password, passkeys, and JWTs that anything can verify against its public keys
payload.description: Starts Better Auth (better-auth-rs, the documented axum setup) on the port in settings.json. It serves sign up, sign in, sessions and passkeys under the base path (default /api/auth), GET /api/auth/token for a JWT (EdDSA, claims sub, iss, aud, exp, iat and the user's email and name) and GET /api/auth/jwks for the public keys. Sessions travel as the __Host-trillion_session cookie or as an Authorization Bearer token. Port, base URL, issuer, audience, passkey relying party, trusted origins and the SQLite file are all in settings.json; the secret comes from the BETTER_AUTH_SECRET environment variable and is never printed.

settings.description: Optional path to a settings file, put where {settings} is in the command. Leave it out to use tools/better-auth/settings.json.

output_schema.description: The server keeps running and answers on the port in settings.json. GET {base_url}{base_path}/ok answers {"ok":true} when it is ready.

needs: rust 1.94 or newer (the folder's rust-toolchain.toml names 1.95.0)
ICU 78 for the build and the run: set RUST_ICU_MAJOR_VERSION_NUMBER=78 and RUST_ICU_LINK_SEARCH_DIR to its lib folder (brew install icu4c@78)
BETTER_AUTH_SECRET in the environment: a random secret of at least 32 characters
invoke.say: This runs on the person's own computer. Set BETTER_AUTH_SECRET from the vault by name (never print it), edit tools/better-auth/settings.json for the port, issuer, passkey origin and database file, then run `run`. The first run builds and takes a few minutes. Check GET {base_url}{base_path}/ok. Anything that verifies a token reads the keys from {base_url}{base_path}/jwks and checks iss and aud against the settings.

provenance.source: better-auth-rs v1.0.0-alpha.5 (git 23c89f4e51), README quick start and examples/axum_server.rs, with the passkey and JWT plugin docs; its own SeaORM adapter and generated schema, no custom adapter
